description: Tick off (or un-tick with done=false) a step of the domain's growth plan after the work has actually been done. Awards XP on first completion and starts result verification. Step keys come from the growth_plan tool. Only available on paid domains — the free preview is read-only. Never call this without an explicit user request.

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

done.description: false un-ticks the step. Defaults to true.

stepKey.description: Step key from the growth_plan structure.

name: complete_plan_step
title: Complete plan step
